player_behavior: Android persists only a boolean pending Run-operation marker; it never stores narrative output, request payloads or credentials in the session record.
On restart, Android clears the marker, returns directly to the remembered Run and explains that the interrupted operation did not write a partial turn.
Desktop uses a tested localStorage marker for choice, free-action and rollback operations; a clean boot consumes it and shows the same player-facing recovery explanation.
A completed, failed or accepted-cancelled operation clears its marker, so the recovery notice is not repeated on normal re-entry.
